confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Helsinki prices; no live listings, menus or booking pages were checked. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; July 2026 hostel and hotel rates are least certain given seasonal swings. Cocktail and wine anchors were cross-checked against the beer anchor (about 1.9x and 1.35x) because direct knowledge is weaker. FX is the 2026-10-14 RBA reading as reported in search results surfacing rba.gov.au pages; the RBA table was not opened directly, and a 2026-10-15 reading seen in one result was unconfirmed and not used.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Estimates are loosely benchmarked against Stockholm, Copenhagen and Oslo, with Helsinki assumed somewhat below Oslo and Copenhagen for restaurants and hotels; prices are quoted in EUR.
